popCulture.title: Omphale
popCulture.description: The Lydian queen who held Heracles in soft bondage — the hero's servitude between the sack of Laomedon's Troy and his later labours.

popCulture.title: Heracles
popCulture.description: The first sack of Ilion and the year of Omphale's spindle — Heracles' Trojan prelude before Priam's city fell to the Achaeans.
